beats.title: Situation
beats.text: Claims handlers at an EU health insurer work through files full of diagnoses, prescriptions and hospital notes. A frontier model would help them check each invoice against the policy, but health data is a special category under the GDPR and may not go to an outside model. We built an assistant that prepares each claim for the handler while the health data stays on a local model.

beats.title: Harness
beats.text: The assistant is a custom harness built on Pi, and every request it makes to a model passes a fixed series of checks that we can test one at a time. A regular-expression pre-mask replaces policy numbers and other identifiers with tokens. A second classifier on BRANE's local model labels the request and can only make the route stricter. BRANE is the gate. It sends the request to the frontier model with placeholders, keeps it on the local model, or refuses it, and the harness has no other path to a model.

beats.title: Loop
beats.text: The agent itself runs in a loop. It calls the model, runs the tool the model asks for, and calls the model again with the result until the claim is ready. While building it we found that the same loop improves the harness. We change one part, such as a pre-mask pattern or a policy rule, run the evals, keep the change only if the scores improve, and go round again.

beats.title: Evals
beats.text: Each check is scored on its own, on Omar Shalaby's labelled requests. We tune on one split and choose between versions on another. BRANE's answers vary, so each case counts at its worst run. Here is where each score started and where it ended.

beats.title: Demo queue
beats.text: Here is the web app. The queue on the left holds the claims. In this claim, Sanne Bakker asks whether her therapy for burnout is covered. Her message and her files fill the message box, and the handler presses Send.

beats.title: Demo trace
beats.text: On the right, the trace fills in while the agent works: pre-mask, intake, BRANE, tools, and the person. By the end, BRANE has kept the requests with health details on the local model, and the request to the frontier model is protected.

beats.title: Demo adviser
beats.text: The agent looks up the policy terms and asks the medical adviser a question. The adviser answers in this card, and the answer goes back to the agent through BRANE, like every other request.

beats.title: Demo decision
beats.text: Now the claims handler decides. The decision card shows the recommendation, the cited terms, and where each request went. The handler approves, and the decision comes back into the chat as a message the agent continues from.

beats.title: Demo audit
beats.text: The audit log tab lists every step and every decision a person made. The approval is a human row, linked to the handoff it answers, and the hash chain is verified.

beats.title: Impact
beats.text: What does this take off the handler's desk? The assistant reads the file, looks up the policy terms and the law, asks the adviser, and drafts a recommendation with its sources. The handler reads it and decides.

beats.title: Close
beats.text: Try it yourself. The app is live with synthetic claims, and the address and the password are on screen. We are Team Gezira.
